definitions.explanation: A jump-rope technique in which the jumper hops on one leg only, instead of the usual two-footed hop, either staying on the same foot or alternating feet. Often introduced as a step toward more advanced jump-rope tricks.

examples.japanese: {片足|かたあし}{跳|と}びをする。
{片足|かたあし}{跳|と}びは⟦{両足|りょうあし}→両足：28926_ryouashi⟧{跳|と}びより⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: The single-leg jump is more tiring than the two-footed jump.

examples.japanese: ⟦{右足|みぎあし}→右足：28272_migiashi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{左足|ひだりあし}→左足：27500_hidariashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交互|こうご}に→交互に：17296_kougoni⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{片足|かたあし}{跳|と}びを{十回|じっかい}ずつ⟦{跳|と}んだ→跳ぶ：19597_tobu⟧。
examples.english: I did ten single-leg jumps on each foot, alternating between my right foot and my left foot.

notes:
{片足|かたあし}{跳|と}び replaces the usual two-footed hop of ⟦{前|まえ}{跳|と}び→前跳び：30927_maetobi⟧ with hopping on one leg only. It builds balance and leg strength and is often practiced as a step up before moving on to harder tricks.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{前|まえ}{跳|と}び→前跳び：30927_maetobi⟧: forward jump
- ⟦{後|うし}ろ{跳|と}び→後ろ跳び：30928_ushirotobi⟧: backward jump
- ⟦{交差|こうさ}{跳|と}び→交差跳び：30929_kousatobi⟧: cross jump

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {片足|かたあし}{跳|と}びをする: to do a single-leg jump
- ⟦{右足|みぎあし}→右足：28272_migiashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{片足|かたあし}{跳|と}びをする: to do a single-leg jump on the right foot
